∀ (M τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (a b : ℝ), 0 < τ →
KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b →
(∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => v r k) (KdVPlan.dt v t k) t) ∧
(∃ p : Finset ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, t ∉ p → ∀ k,
HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.interp τ f r k) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.interp τ f) t k) t ∧
HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.err τ f v r k) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.err τ f v) t k) t)
proof:
intro M τ L f v a b hτ htr hg
have hv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => v r k) (KdVPlan.dt v t k) t := by
  intro t ht k
  have hti : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) := ⟨hg.1.trans_lt ht.1,ht.2.trans_le hg.2.2.1⟩
  exact (((htr.2.2.1.1 k).differentiableOn (by simp) t ⟨hti.1.le,hti.2.le⟩).differentiableAt (Icc_mem_nhds hti.1 hti.2)).hasDerivAt
refine ⟨hv,?_⟩
have hpp := (h_T007.2.2.2 τ f L hτ htr.1 htr.2.1).1
have hp' := (@yui_aux_0089 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).2.1 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) a b _ hg.1 hg.2.2.1 hpp
rcases @yui_aux_0107 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 a b _ hp' with ⟨p,hp⟩
refine ⟨p,?_⟩
intro t ht htp k
have hV := hp t ht htp k
have he := ((hv t ht k).sub hV).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
refine ⟨hV,?_⟩
simpa only [KdVPlan.err,KdVPlan.dt,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.sub_def] using he
